title: HSK2 Gate 21 · Late Qing
explanationEn: Gate 21: Late Qing. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第21关：清后期。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 清朝到了后来，国家出了很多问题。很多官不好好做事，只想自己拿钱。人们的日子越来越不好过，很多人吃不饱饭。有的地方，人们站出来跟官府打仗。
passageEn: Late in the Qing dynasty, the country ran into many problems. Many officials did not do their jobs properly, and thought only of lining their pockets. Life grew harder and harder, and many people could not get enough to eat. In some places people stood up and fought the government.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: Late in the Qing dynasty, the country ran into many problems.
comprehension.answer: 清朝到了后来，国家出了很多问题。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: Life grew harder and harder, and many people could not get enough to eat.
comprehension.answer: 人们的日子越来越不好过，很多人吃不饱饭。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 到 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“到”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 到 (dào) means "to reach" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “到”（dào）的意思是“to reach”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 后来 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“后来”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 后来 (hòu lái) means "later on" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “后来”（hòu lái）的意思是“later on”，就在上面的短文里。

check.zh: 清朝到了后来，国家出了很多问题。

options.text: People had nowhere to live, and could only go up the mountains to live.
Late in the Qing dynasty, the country ran into many problems.
Long, long ago, it rained in China for many days, and a great flood came.
The flood went into the fields, and into many people's homes.

check.explanationEn: "清朝到了后来，国家出了很多问题。" means "Late in the Qing dynasty, the country ran into many problems.".
check.explanation: “清朝到了后来，国家出了很多问题。”的意思是“Late in the Qing dynasty, the country ran into many problems.”。

speakingPromptEn: Tell a grown-up about Late Qing in two or three short Chinese sentences. Use words from the list above.
speakingPrompt: 用上面的词，跟家里的大人说两三句中文，说一说清后期。
